events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Freddie Mercury, who would have turned 80. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the trailblazing Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce spirit have made The Pretenders a rock institution.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher turns 54 today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1971)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1971, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing music consumption forever.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? On this day in 2001, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and redefined how we listen to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating the enduring legacy of 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire a world to imagine.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, the incomparable John Cleese turns 87 today! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles release 'White Album' (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate and delight.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death (1991)
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who sadly passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the incredible life and undeniable talent of Freddie Mercury, who left us far too soon in 1991. His legend lives on.

events.title: The Beatles release 'Rubber Soul' (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant evolution in their sound and songwriting. A true classic.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death (1980)
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical giant. We remember John Lennon, whose legacy of peace and powerful music continues to resonate.
